pi.note: Pi has no built-in Model Context Protocol client, so Baltor connects through a small Pi extension. Save the extension this website serves at /assets/pi/baltor.ts as .pi/extensions/baltor.ts in your project folder, and read it first: Pi runs every extension in that folder with your permissions. Then create this file beside it. This file holds the name of the variable, never the token. The extension adds two tools, baltor_search and baltor_download. A download checks the published SHA-256 digest before it writes anything, then installs the skill in .pi/skills.
